scripts.package: pnpm --workspace-root build -- --server-only && node scripts/prepare-packaging.mjs && node scripts/run-forge.mjs package
scripts.make: pnpm --workspace-root build -- --server-only && node scripts/prepare-packaging.mjs && node scripts/run-forge.mjs make
scripts.make:dmg:prepared: node scripts/prepare-packaging.mjs && node scripts/run-forge.mjs make --targets dmg
